scripts.build: ${npm_execpath} run lint && sass src/lib:dist && ${npm_execpath} run minify-css
scripts.watch: sass --watch src/lib:dist & nodemon --watch dist --ext css --ignore "*.min.css" --exec "${npm_execpath} run minify-css"
scripts.minify-css: find dist -name "*.css" -not -name "*.min.css" -exec sh -c 'for file; do ${npm_execpath} cleancss -o "${file%.css}.min.css" "$file"; done' sh {} +
